name: stellar-trace
description: Index Stellar contract events into SQLite — a resumable getEvents ingest loop that stores raw XDR.

scripts.//: `build` typechecks rather than emitting: nothing here is published, and the repo's generic matrix runs `npm run build --if-present`, so this is where a type error gets caught in CI.
scripts.//vercel-build: Vercel runs this instead of `build` when it's present. It typechecks, then rebuilds demo.db from the committed fixture so the deployed function has a database to open — the same thing `npm run demo` does locally.
scripts.vercel-build: tsc --noEmit && rm -f demo.db && tsx src/bin/ingest.ts --offline --db demo.db --once
